# Medical 360 (Mauritius) — AI & LLM Context File
> Medical 360 (Med360 Ltd) is Mauritius's premier international medical concierge service connecting patients across the Indian Ocean (Mauritius, Réunion, Madagascar, Seychelles, Comoros) with accredited top-tier hospitals in India, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Europe.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Free Medical Second Opinion**: Review of medical records by world-renowned specialists within 24–48 hours.
- **Accredited Hospital Network**: Apollo Hospitals (India), Fortis Healthcare (India), Medanta - The Medicity (India), Bumrungrad International Hospital (Thailand), Gleneagles (Malaysia), Mount Elizabeth (Singapore).
- **Cost Estimation & Savings**: Up to 70% savings on major cardiac surgery, cancer therapies, robotic joint replacement, organ transplantation, and neurosurgery compared to European or local private rates.
- **Full End-to-End Travel Concierge**: Medical visa assistance, priority hospital appointment scheduling, airport transfers, local accommodation, and dedicated Mauritian patient coordinator.
